rows.displayName: An isomorphism of the free group factors

claim.ja: n≥3の隣接階数、階数2と3、1<r≤∞の補間族が同型。基本群はR>0。四つの自由エントロピー次元は生成組に依存する。
claim.en: Consecutive ranks n≥3, ranks two and three, and all interpolated parameters 1<r≤∞ are isomorphic. Fundamental groups are R>0; four free entropy dimensions depend on generators.

role.ja: 小cocycle→トレース保存flow→適応誤差予算による生成極限。増幅・二分法・生成組移送を後続で使用。日英概説と自己点検を用意。
role.en: Small cocycle → tracial flow → generating limit with adaptive error budgets; followed by amplification, dichotomy, and transport of tuples. Bilingual account and self-check prepared.
